bead.colors.strength: Colors window: label of the colour strength slider.
bead.colors.studio: Colors window: header tab for the page that explores one wallpaper's colours.

bead.colors.style-harmony-text: Colors window: description under the style buttons when Harmony is chosen.

bead.colors.target-second: Colors window: name of the second accent colour slot.

bead.panel.sound-mute: Accessible name of the button that mutes or unmutes the sound output.
bead.panel.sound-title: Title of the sound output panel (also the heading of the audio status view).
bead.panel.sound-volume: Accessible name of the output volume slider.
bead.panel.status-data-unavailable: Status panel (network, Bluetooth, battery and sound popouts from the bar): secondary line: the desktop daemon has not delivered this status.
bead.panel.status-heading: Status panel: placeholder heading before the view knows which device it shows.
bead.panel.status-none: Status panel: placeholder primary line before any status arrives.
bead.panel.status-stale: Status panel (network, Bluetooth, battery and sound popouts from the bar): secondary line: the shown status is the last one received and may be out of date.
bead.panel.status-unavailable: Status panel (network, Bluetooth, battery and sound popouts from the bar): primary line when the data of a view is missing; {name} is the translated view name (Network, Bluetooth, Battery, Sound output).
bead.panel.tray-close: Accessible name of the button that closes a system tray menu.
bead.panel.tray-empty: Shown in a system tray menu that has no entries.
bead.panel.wifi: Label of the Wi-Fi power row. Product name Wi-Fi is normally kept as is.
bead.panel.wifi-change-failed: Status panel (network, Bluetooth, battery and sound popouts from the bar): message under the Wi-Fi switch after switching the radio failed.
bead.panel.wifi-changing: Status panel (network, Bluetooth, battery and sound popouts from the bar): message under the Wi-Fi switch while the change is in progress.
bead.panel.wifi-control-unavailable: Status panel (network, Bluetooth, battery and sound popouts from the bar): message under the Wi-Fi switch: the radio cannot be controlled right now.
bead.panel.wifi-off: Status panel (network, Bluetooth, battery and sound popouts from the bar): secondary line of the network view: the Wi-Fi radio is off.
bead.panel.wifi-on: Status panel (network, Bluetooth, battery and sound popouts from the bar): secondary line of the network view: the Wi-Fi radio is on.
bead.panel.wifi-radio: Accessible name of the switch that turns the Wi-Fi radio on or off.
bead.settings.add: Settings window: label of the button that starts adding an entry to a list setting.
bead.settings.apply: Settings window: button that confirms a pending change to a setting that needs an explicit apply.
bead.settings.changed-elsewhere: Settings window: shown when saving failed because the stored settings changed meanwhile.
bead.settings.custom-unavailable: Settings window: placeholder line for a settings section whose editor is not built yet.
bead.settings.default-value: Settings window: value shown for a text setting that is empty and so uses the default.
bead.settings.discard: Settings window: button that drops a pending change to a setting that needs apply.
bead.settings.no-results: Settings window: shown when a search matches no setting or page.
bead.settings.not-here: Settings window: ends a line such as Name: not available in Bead yet for an unsupported setting.
bead.settings.read-only: Settings window: note under the page title when the page can be viewed but not edited yet.
bead.settings.remove: Settings window: accessible name prefix of the button that removes one entry of a list setting.
bead.settings.move-up: Settings window: accessible name suffix of the button that moves one entry of a list setting up.
bead.settings.move-down: Settings window: accessible name suffix of the button that moves one entry of a list setting down.
bead.settings.requires-apply: Settings window: explains that the chosen value only takes effect after pressing Apply.
bead.settings.save: Settings window: accessible name of the button that saves the edited text of a setting.
bead.settings.save-failed: Settings window: shown when the daemon refused or lost a setting change.
bead.settings.search-placeholder: Settings window: placeholder and accessible name of the search field in the sidebar.
bead.settings.search-results: Settings window: page title while a search query is shown instead of a page.
bead.settings.title: Settings window: title of the window shown by the window manager.
bead.settings.unavailable-now: Settings window: shown when settings cannot be changed because the daemon is unreachable.
